## Findings
- claim-1: `source-30` is not a citable indexed source, and `source-29` has no supplied citable source block; thus the requested exhaustive extraction and status comparison cannot be performed.
- claim-2: No bounded primary-source excerpts establish the complete list of explicitly labelled “Conjecture,” “Question,” or “Problem” in `source-30`, nor the status of any such item in `source-29`.
## Strategy
Restrict to `source-30` and `source-29`. No citable blocks or stable locators for either are supplied, so no extraction or status matching is possible without inventing evidence.

## Gaps
The certificate is not established. Missing: source identities/availability records, exhaustive labelled-item excerpts from `source-30`, and itemwise status excerpts (or an explicit no-status inspection record) from `source-29`.

## Next
Provide citable, bounded source blocks for `source-30` and `source-29`, including stable locators sufficient to audit exhaustiveness and each status comparison.
